observed: Symbol renders as an elongated, flat-bottomed oval loaf with three diagonal scoring cuts (evenodd gaps). At 320px, 96px and the 64px specimen it reads as a hogaza. The hard-hat/bun reading from review 1 is gone.

At 24px (declared minimum) on cream and on dark, the silhouette stays a loaf and the three cuts are still countable, though thin. At 32px they are clear. The silhouette carries the mark and the cuts are secondary.
recommendation: None. 24px is the correct floor; do not declare anything smaller.

observed: Desktop composite grid is a full 2x2 (symbol, wordmark, lockup, inverse lockup on dark panel) with no orphan panel. Lockup sits on one line with no wrap. Phone stacks all four cleanly at 390px with no horizontal scroll.

wordmark.svg, lockup.svg and lockup-inverse.svg render Source Serif 4 Bold as outlined paths, consistent with the page headline and the typography specimen. No fallback face is visible in any SVG at any size, including the accent on the u.

Inverse lockup is cream (#F4EEE3) on Brasa (#221C18), 14.6:1 per the palette sheet. It is crisp on the page's dark panel and in the standalone render. The faded cream-on-light strip in the standalone render is an intentional framing artefact, not a use case. The sheet states the rule: on Brasa the mark goes in cream.

The page renders Source Serif 4 and Inter (not the Georgia or system fallback). README says the fonts are woff2, latin-subset, SIL OFL 1.1, with no external requests. The Taste lint reports 0 fail and the render log has no DEFECT lines.

README now describes the hand-written SVGs, the wordmark converted to curves, both lockups, fonts/ and the render, taste and review artefact trail. It matches the files on disk and the rendered page. The stale claims from before are gone.

The sheet reports Terracotta on Crema at 4.4:1 and labels it 'solo gráficos y texto grande'. It marks Tinta/Corteza on Brasa as 'no usar'. Body text is Tinta on Crema at 13.2:1. Terracotta appears only in the symbol and the bold large wordmark (logo text is exempt from WCAG contrast). No unlabelled text falls below the floor.

The declared 120px minimum logotype width renders around 11-12px text. It is legible in the outlined serif but is the practical floor. The 32px lockup preview in the render is too small to read as text.
recommendation: Optional: note that the lockup should not go below the 120px logotype minimum. This is not a defect as published.
